decisionsTitle: Every email the club or a colleague receives starts with fixed, filterable tags
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15 ~20:25:** «I need better email names so I can filter in Gmail, e.g. „Cum a fost: Running Up That Hilly Tâmpa cu Brașov Runners” should have this prefix [contact][feedback][type] — this way I can categorize.» This amends §307 (QA's `[QA]` mark on the subject), §676 (the four «Spune-ne ceva» forms), §778 (the visitors' messages and the platform's notice about a road through the outbox), §149 («Scrie-ne») and the decisions of the staff notices it touches: §245 (the registrations notice), §99 and §393 (the declarations' archive copy), §639 and §775 (the templates' digest), §657 (the unreachable-window notices), §683 (the members' shop), §754 (a volunteer's sign-up notice), §141 and §524 (the invitations).

**Decision.**

1. **One place knows the tags:** `notifications/domain/subject-tags.ts` — the vocabulary (`SUBJECT_TAGS`), the map from a message type to its tags (`SUBJECT_TAGS_OF`, a `Record` over the types the audience map of §670 says reach the club or a colleague, so a type added there does not compile until somebody gives it a family), the four forms' tags (`FEEDBACK_FORM_TAGS`) and the two builders (`tagSubject`, `markAfterTags`). The tags are fixed ASCII, lowercase, never translated, in no `messages/*.json`; changing one is changing every mailbox's filter, so it takes a decision.
2. **The table.** `[contact]` — «Scrie-ne». `[feedback]` plus the form: `[cum-a-fost]`, `[sugestie]`, `[reclamatie]`, `[girl-zone]`. `[inscrieri]` — «somebody has confirmed» (§245). `[declaratii]` — the archive copy of a signed declaration, one-off and group run (§99, §393). `[voluntari]` — the organizers' notice of a volunteer's sign-up (§754). `[legal]` — the Administrators' digest of moved templates (§639, §775). `[livrare]` — the platform's notices about the email roads: a road is down, a message could not be delivered (§778). `[sistem]` — the unreachable-window alerts (§657). `[magazin]` — the club's notice of a shop order (§683). `[echipa]` — the invitation of a colleague (§141).
3. **The shape:** `[tag][tag] human words` — `[feedback][cum-a-fost] Cum a fost: Running Up That Hilly Tâmpa cu Brașov Runners`. A staff template's subject is `tags + "RO / EN"` (the tags once, before the two halves). **On QA the environment's mark comes first and is joined to the tags** — `[QA][feedback][cum-a-fost] …`; any subject that does not start with a tag keeps `[QA] ` and its space, as before (`markSubjectForEnvironment`, still idempotent, now on the bare `[QA]`). The mark of §310 moves after the tags: `[contact][posibil spam] Mesaj de pe site: …`, `[QA][feedback][sugestie][posibil spam] …`; a filter on the phrase `"[posibil spam]"` is unchanged, and the constant is now `SUSPICIOUS_SUBJECT_MARK`.
4. **Never tagged:** an email to a participant, a volunteer, a subscriber, an invitee of the public or a member — their subjects are what they were, a test walks every one. The audience map (§670) files three member-facing types loosely under «staff» (the shop's order placed and order paid receipts, a member's invitation); `MEMBER_FACING` takes them out of the tagged set, so a club's filter is not in a member's inbox. The club's copy of a participant's message (§320) keeps its own `[Copie club]` mark.
5. **Girl Zone.** The owner asked for `[feedback][girl-zone]`, and the human words stay the neutral «Mesaj confidențial de pe site» (§676). The tag does show in a notification's preview, where the neutral words alone would not — a trade-off the owner accepted by asking for the filter; SETUP.md tells the person to hide previews or silence that label. **A message that goes to Girl Zone's person — from any form, by the sender's choice of «Cine să afle?» (§678) — carries `[girl-zone]` and not its form's tag**: the subject there is neutral on purpose and the form is named in the body only, and the one filter that must never forward is then true of every message that reached her. SETUP.md's «Filtre în Gmail» says so, gives the ready-to-paste filters, and writes the `[feedback]` filter as `subject:"[feedback]" -subject:"[girl-zone]"`, so that a forward or a shared label made from it cannot carry her messages along.

**Open points decided (the owner's standing word is «YOLO»).** (a) `[livrare]`, not the `[email]` the brief floated: Gmail searches words and ignores brackets, so `subject:"[email]"` would also catch every subject with the word «email»; the other tags are words the human subjects do not use, or use for the same family («magazin», «echipa»). (b) A colleague's invitation is tagged (`[echipa]`) and so is the club's notice of a shop order (`[magazin]`); the shop's two receipts to a member and a member's invitation are not: they go to the member, not to the club, and a club's filter is not in a member's inbox (`MEMBER_FACING`). (c) A `[Copie club]` stays as it is: it is a participant's message, already filterable by its own words (SETUP.md gives its filter line). (d) The tag follows the type, not the recipient's role: nothing here changes who receives what or how a message is sent. (e) No migration, no new dependency, no new setting.

**Refused.** Translating a tag; a tag per event or per sender; reading the tags from the settings (a filter is only as stable as its words); tagging a participant's mail "for symmetry"; a banner or a task row for the filters (SETUP.md carries them).
changelogLine: - **Filterable tags at the start of the club's email subjects** — «Scrie-ne» is `[contact]`, the four «Spune-ne ceva» forms `[feedback][cum-a-fost]`, `[sugestie]`, `[reclamatie]`, `[girl-zone]`, and the staff notices `[inscrieri]`, `[declaratii]`, `[voluntari]`, `[legal]`, `[livrare]`, `[sistem]`, `[magazin]` (the club's notice of a shop order), `[echipa]` (a colleague's invitation); QA's mark comes first (`[QA][feedback][cum-a-fost] …`); runners', volunteers' and members' subjects are unchanged; SETUP.md has the Gmail filters, and a note that Girl Zone's messages are never forwarded. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given any message type that reaches the club's mailboxes or a colleague (the audiences «club» and «staff», but not the three that go to a member: the shop's receipts and a member's invitation), when its subject is built, then it starts with that type's fixed ASCII tags from the one map — `[contact]`, `[feedback]` plus the form's tag, `[inscrieri]`, `[declaratii]`, `[voluntari]`, `[legal]`, `[livrare]`, `[sistem]`, `[magazin]`, `[echipa]` — followed by the human words, a staff template's tags once before its Romanian and English halves; a walk over the audience map fails when a type of those two audiences has no tag; and on QA the environment's `[QA]` mark comes first and is joined to the tags (`[QA][feedback][cum-a-fost] …`) while a subject without tags keeps `[QA] ` and its space, the mark being idempotent (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `notifications/subject-tags.test.ts`.

Given a message to a participant, a volunteer, a subscriber, an invitee of the public or a member (their shop receipts, their invitation), when its subject is built, then it carries no tag and is what it was; the club's copy of a participant's message keeps its own `[Copie club]` mark (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `notifications/subject-tags.test.ts`.

Amends criteria 3, 29, 34 and 41: Given a message through «Scrie-ne», when it is composed, then its subject is `[contact] Mesaj de pe site: <name>`; given a message through one of the four «Spune-ne ceva» forms, then it is `[feedback][cum-a-fost] Cum a fost: <event>`, `[feedback][sugestie] …`, `[feedback][reclamatie] …` or `[feedback][girl-zone] Mesaj confidențial de pe site`, a message that goes to Girl Zone's person from any form carrying `[feedback][girl-zone]` and the neutral words; and the mark «[posibil spam]» of a suspect message follows the tags, never precedes them (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `notifications/subject-tags.test.ts`, `feedback/branches.test.ts`, `contact/message.test.ts`; integration `feedback/submit.test.ts`, `contact/service.test.ts`.

batchLine: filterable tags at the start of the club's email subjects
